# Black Forest Labs Data Processing Terms (demo mirror)

Illustrative content for the Night's Watch hackathon demo. Not Black Forest Labs' actual terms.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

## Scope

These terms describe how Black Forest Labs processes customer data on behalf of its customers when providing its image generation API.

## Use of customer data

We process prompts and generated images only to deliver the API to the customer. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention

Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination. Tax and invoice records are retained for 7 years as required by law.

## Security

Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and generated images are served from access-controlled storage. We train our support staff on data protection every year.

## Changes to sub-processors

We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor. We publish every change on our sub-processors page.
